summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing the mutual termination of its August 2, 2022 License, Distribution and Supply Agreement with Mercury Pharma Group Limited (ADVANZ PHARMA) for European commercialization of D-PLEX100. No termination fee, price per share, or premium was disclosed. European rights revert to PolyPid, which retains its recent North American partnership with Azurity Pharmaceuticals. The company cited Phase 3 SHIELD II success and NDA/EMA submissions as transformative milestones, positioning D-PLEX as attractive for new European partners. Watch for a replacement European licensing deal, potential upfront or milestone payments, and any related financing, which would drive the equity narrative.
